reviews.review: I really enjoyed this game while there are many other games with the same playstyle I really enjoyed running around on a Forge World fighting off enimes of the Emperor Of Mankind. Only a couple things i did not really like one being any extended shooting event it just did not feel "right" like short bursts of gunfire mixed in with just bashing and hacking things to death. There was a moment during one of the jetpack events were I fell through the ground and just fell into nothingness. But even with that I still really enjoyed the game and I recomend it to anyone who likes this type of game and to people who enjoy the Warhammer 40K Universe

This game will make you feel like a badass Buzz Lightyear.

Warhammer 40k: Space Marine is a third person shooter that puts you in the boots of the Ultramarines (actually is a veteran of sorts but his character ain't as interesting as Gabriel Angelos), whose mission is to save the planet Graia from a Xenos invasion and recover its endangered yet precious assets.

The story comes as somewhat of a letdown, while the premise feels promising, a lack of execution as well as not much development of the characters aside from exposition makes the whole experience an unsatisfying thing. The races presented here also aren't as well represented nor do they feel a part from a larger universe (imo, the first Warhammer 40k: Dawn of War did this succesfully).

+Pros:
Solid mechanics: The shooting as well as the melee attacks are ok, they won't glitch out and they are easy to understand.


-Cons/nitpicking:
Lame color use: Seriously, this game only reminds me of two colors for some reasons, ♥♥♥♥ brown and gray ash.
Bug presence (and this is worse than tyranids): I have encountered two bugs during my playthrough that had me resetting the game. One during chapter 3 and other during chapter 7, for some reason certain doors that needed two be activated never prompted the needed button to interact with them, leaving me in a state of limbo. So...consider that if you must.
It doesn't do anything new: It feels generic at times unfortunately.

In conclusion I can only recommend this game on discount or for Warhammer fans looking for more like myself.
